name: preview-card-1r
title: Preview Card 1r: Passe-partout
author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
description: A catalogue card for showing a live component preview. A mat frame inside the card, like a framed print, with a small-caps caption.
docs: Every preview card design exports the same `PreviewCard` component, so you can switch designs by changing the import path. Pass the live preview as children.
